title: Bellwether Clinic implementation - raw capture
content:
Purpose: quick personal capture from 2025-11-18 kickoff + follow-ups. Not polished — working notes for SE handoff and prep for the next technical sync. Customer: Bellwether Clinic (regional chain of urgent care clinics). Objective: production-grade conversational triage assistant deployed in their VPC with on-prem data connectors for EHR lookups.

Key constraints they stated:
- No PHI leaves VPC. Everything must be encrypted at rest and in transit, with KMS integration (they use Azure Key Vault).
- Target 95th percentile latency < 400ms for single-turn triage checks (short prompts, token lengths ~30–80). For multi-turn, sub-700ms acceptable.
- Expected concurrency: 15–30 concurrent users per clinic during peak. Pilot across 6 clinics -> target steady RPS approx 100.
- Audit log retention 7 years, but legal will confirm exact retention policy for event logs.

Meeting notes (raw):
- Product and clinical leads on call: Dr. Han, Priya (ops). They care deeply about fallback behavior and auditability.
- They asked about offline fallback: we suggested local stateless model variant + stub responses with escalation to human triage.
- Concern: hallucination on medication contraindications. They want an explicit safeguard: rule-based blocklist for any medication advice + alert to clinician.
- Data connector: Epic/Intergy (legacy). They will provide read-only service account and a staging dataset next week.

Technical items to validate:
- Network: VPC peering vs private link? They prefer private endpoint over peering because of central infra policies.
- KMS: confirm AV Key Vault API compatibility with Redwood Private KMS adapter.
- Model: start with curated open clinical-safe model (quantized) + Canary to a larger model for fallback.
- KV cache: TTL for patient context must be short; avoid storing PHI beyond session. Use ephemeral session IDs and per-call masking.

Gotchas / red flags:
- Their Intergy instance uses legacy TLS ciphers. Need infra to support older cipher negotiation or ask them to update.
- Legal asked about cognitive load: audit log format must make it easy to reconstruct the assistant's exact output and decision path.
- Onboarding docs: their SOC2 audit team will want access to our control plane audit logs — likely blocked in full private deployment. Need to propose redacted export flow.

Sample prompts / expected user flows (for devs):
- User: "I have chest pain and nausea, what should I do?" -> Assistant should run checklist: red flags -> immediate escalation if present -> otherwise suggest clinic booking + recommended vitals check.
- System instruction: "Only provide general guidance. If asked for medication changes, respond with 'I cannot provide medication changes; please consult clinician' and route to clinician chat."

Action items (who/when):
- Evan: confirm Key Vault adapter compatibility by 2025-11-25 (PR / compatibility matrix).
- Maya: get sample Intergy staging export and sample TLS config by 2025-11-22.
- Samir (me): draft canary rollout plan and latency SLO proposal for pilot by 2025-11-24.
- SE team: prepare PB for on-prem agent that enforces encryption + redaction for logs (estimate 2 wks).

Next sync agenda (2025-11-26):
1) Demo minimal flow (no EHR) in our sandbox, emphasize hallucination safeguards.
2) Review sample staging dataset and connector auth.
3) Confirm logging/retention approach acceptable to legal.
4) Validate latency numbers with simulated load (100 RPS) and present initial throughput guidance.

Open questions for legal/infra: 
- Exact log retention window and whether aggregated telemetry is acceptable to export off-VPC.
- Can we accept service account access with IP allowlist only, or do they require MFA for machine accounts?

Notes to self:
- Keep prompts short and structured during pilot; prefer function-calling pattern for EHR lookups rather than free text queries to reduce hallucination surface.
- Recommend using a smaller quantized model for routine triage answers and auto-escalate to higher-capacity model only when clinical confidence < 0.7 (we need to define confidence heuristics).
- Prepare an A/B test for 'explainability' UI: show the bullet list of explicit checks that led to escalation.

Reference links to include in handoff doc:
- internal runbook: /confluence/ops/private-deploy-onramp-template
- recommended rollout guide: https://redwood.internal/rtd/canary-rollouts

End of capture. Rough, iterative. Will clean up into SE handoff doc before 2025-11-24.
summary: Kickoff capture for Bellwether Clinic private deployment pilot: PHI guardrails, latency targets, EHR connector, audit requirements, action items assigned.
